description: This PHP script handles the saving process for EmailTemplate records in SuiteCRM. It initializes a new EmailTemplate bean, populates it from POST data, and saves it. Additionally, it manages caching and client-side UI updates depending on whether it is in a popup window or not.

classes.name: EmailTemplateFormBase
classes.description: Form handler class for email templates, providing save functionality.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles the process of saving an EmailTemplate, including validation and persistence.
